svg.title: J6 Customer page: UPI QR code and a printable statement

g.text: J6 Customer page: UPI QR code and a printable statement
v1.2 add-on profile.js, on each render:
a "Balance over time" line drawn as inline SVG,
one point per entry, with the highest and lowest balance
qrLib reset, so the next tap tries again
the customer scans the code on the owner's screen with any UPI app
waits at most 1.5 s for the QR library;
